GET /v1/presentations/request.description: List your tenant's OpenID4VP (OpenID for Verifiable Presentations) presentation requests. This alias returns the same bare JSON array as `GET /v1/presentations/requests`.

200.description: Returns a bare JSON array. Each array element is one presentation request.

transaction_id.description: Binds the presentation request to the later verification result.

dcql.description: Contains the DCQL (Digital Credentials Query Language) query the wallet evaluates.

credentials.description: Lists the credential queries in the presentation request.

id.description: Identifies the credential query inside the DCQL (Digital Credentials Query Language) payload.

format.description: Names the credential format requested by this query.

meta.description: Carries metadata that constrains matching credentials.

vct_values.description: Lists accepted VCT (Verifiable Credential Type) values.

items.description: One accepted VCT (Verifiable Credential Type) value.

claims.description: Lists the claim paths the verifier asks the holder to disclose.

items.description: One segment of the requested claim path.

requested_vct.description: Names the requested VCT (Verifiable Credential Type).

requested_claims.description: Lists the claim names the verifier asks the holder to disclose.

aud.description: Identifies the verifier audience for the presentation.

nonce.description: Carries the nonce the wallet must bind into the presentation response.

purpose.description: Explains why the verifier requests the presentation.
purpose.example: Verify loyalty tier for lounge access

trusted_iss.description: Returns the trusted issuer value configured for the request.

status.description: Shows the current state of the presentation request.

created_at.description: Records when the presentation request was created.

requested_vct.description: Names the requested VCT (Verifiable Credential Type).

requested_claims.description: Lists the claim names the verifier asks the holder to disclose.

nonce.description: Carries the nonce the wallet must bind into the presentation response.

GET /v1/presentations/{uuid}/request.description: Fetch the public OpenID4VP (OpenID for Verifiable Presentations) request parameters for a wallet. You receive the response mode, response URI, state, nonce, and DCQL (Digital Credentials Query Language) query.

params.name: uuid
params.description: Identifies the presentation request to dereference.

client_id.description: Identifies the verifier client for the wallet.

response_type.description: Tells the wallet to return a verifiable presentation token.

response_mode.description: Tells the wallet to post the response directly to the response URI.

state.description: Carries the transaction state the wallet returns with the response.

nonce.description: Carries the nonce the wallet must bind into the presentation response.

dcql_query.description: Contains the DCQL (Digital Credentials Query Language) query the wallet evaluates.

credentials.description: Lists the credential queries in the wallet request.

id.description: Identifies the credential query inside the DCQL (Digital Credentials Query Language) payload.

format.description: Names the credential format requested by this query.

meta.description: Carries metadata that constrains matching credentials.

vct_values.description: Lists accepted VCT (Verifiable Credential Type) values.

items.description: One accepted VCT (Verifiable Credential Type) value.

claims.description: Lists the claim paths the verifier asks the holder to disclose.

items.description: One segment of the requested claim path.

GET /v1/verifications.description: List completed verification results for your tenant. Each result shows the verdict, requested claims, disclosed claims, verifier, and verification checks.

200.description: Returns a bare JSON array. Each array element is one verification result.

request_id.description: Identifies the presentation request that produced this result.

verdict.description: Shows whether verification succeeded or failed.

vct.description: Names the VCT (Verifiable Credential Type) that was verified.

verifier.description: Identifies the verifier audience for the presentation.

requested_claims.description: Lists the claim names requested for disclosure.

disclosed_claims.description: Contains the claims the holder disclosed. The object is empty when the verdict is `failed`.

checks.description: Reports the verification checks recorded for this result.

alg_allowlist.description: Shows whether the signing algorithms passed the allowlist check.

aud.description: Shows whether the audience check passed.

key_binding.description: Shows whether the KB-JWT (Key-Binding JWT) holder binding check passed.

nonce.description: Shows whether the nonce check passed.

not_expired.description: Shows whether the credential was still valid at verification time.

not_revoked.description: Shows whether the credential passed the revocation check.

signature.description: Shows whether the credential signature check passed.

error.description: Returns an empty string on success or a failure reason when verification fails.

created_at.description: Records when the verification result was created.

POST /v1/presentations/request.description: Create an OpenID4VP (OpenID for Verifiable Presentations) presentation request. You provide the requested VCT (Verifiable Credential Type), requested claims, audience, and purpose, and the API returns a nonce plus a DCQL (Digital Credentials Query Language) query.

requested_vct.description: Names the VCT (Verifiable Credential Type) you want the holder to present.

requested_claims.description: Lists the claim names you want the holder to disclose.

aud.description: Identifies your verifier audience for the presentation.

purpose.description: Explains why you request the presentation.
purpose.example: Verify loyalty tier for lounge access

transaction_id.description: Binds the presentation request to the later verification result.

dcql.description: Contains the DCQL (Digital Credentials Query Language) query the wallet evaluates.

credentials.description: Lists the credential queries in the presentation request.

id.description: Identifies the credential query inside the DCQL (Digital Credentials Query Language) payload.

format.description: Names the credential format requested by this query.

meta.description: Carries metadata that constrains matching credentials.

vct_values.description: Lists accepted VCT (Verifiable Credential Type) values.

items.description: One accepted VCT (Verifiable Credential Type) value.

claims.description: Lists the claim paths the verifier asks the holder to disclose.

items.description: One segment of the requested claim path.

requested_vct.description: Names the requested VCT (Verifiable Credential Type).

requested_claims.description: Lists the claim names requested for disclosure.

aud.description: Identifies the verifier audience for the presentation.

nonce.description: Carries the nonce the wallet must bind into the presentation response.

purpose.description: Explains why the verifier requests the presentation.
purpose.example: Verify loyalty tier for lounge access

trusted_iss.description: Returns the trusted issuer value configured for the request.

status.description: Shows the initial state of the presentation request.

created_at.description: Records when the presentation request was created.

POST /v1/presentations/{uuid}/response.description: Submit a wallet response for an OpenID4VP (OpenID for Verifiable Presentations) presentation request. You post the `vp_token`, and the API verifies the SD-JWT VC (Selective-Disclosure JWT Verifiable Credential), KB-JWT (Key-Binding JWT), nonce, audience, revocation status, and signature.

params.name: uuid
params.description: Identifies the presentation request being answered.

vp_token.description: Contains the OpenID4VP (OpenID for Verifiable Presentations) presentation token from the wallet.

verdict.description: Shows whether the presentation verified successfully.

disclosed_claims.description: Contains the claims the holder disclosed.

checks.description: Reports the verification checks recorded for this response.

alg_allowlist.description: Shows whether the signing algorithms passed the allowlist check.

aud.description: Shows whether the audience check passed.

key_binding.description: Shows whether the KB-JWT (Key-Binding JWT) holder binding check passed.

nonce.description: Shows whether the nonce check passed.

not_expired.description: Shows whether the credential was still valid at verification time.

not_revoked.description: Shows whether the credential passed the revocation check.

signature.description: Shows whether the credential signature check passed.

error.description: Returns an empty string on success or a failure reason when verification fails.

created_at.description: Records when the verification result was created.

422.description: Returns a failed presentation response when verification rejects the submitted token.

checks.description: Returns the checks captured for the failed response.
